title: Seacrest Beach "Heaven on 30A" 145 Clareon Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private gated beach access - Short stroll to the beach- Low-Speed Vehicle and bike parking at beach access. - Complimentary lithium battery golf cart- Private pool with screened-in patio, grilling area, and outdoor dining- Professionally decorated interior- Entertainment options include table games, cornhole, and a foosball table- Fitness enthusiasts can enjoy a Peloton bike- Fiber internet with lightning-fast speeds up to 2 Gbps- Convenient amenities: 4 adult bikes, 7 beach chairs, gas fire pit- Rigorous cleanliness with Complete Clean Linen Participant certification- Enjoy plush, complimentary beach towels for your use throughout your stayDetails: Discover the epitome of 30A coastal living at "Heaven on 30A." This 3-story, 4-bedroom retreat, boasting 4 baths plus 2 half-baths, accommodates up to 18 guests and is a mere stroll or bike ride from Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, and The Big Chill.The chef’s kitchen, adorned with marble countertops and designer cabinets, features premium stainless Jenn-Air appliances, including a 6-burner gas stove and a Keurig coffeemaker. The dining area offers bar seating for 5 and a farm table for 10, complemented by a half-bath for convenience.Relax in either of the two living rooms, one with a generous 65” TV and a cozy sectional, the other featuring a love seat and comfortable chairs with a 55” TV. The first floor also hosts a laundry room for keeping your vacation wardrobe fresh.The primary bedroom, located on the first floor, boasts a private bath with a shower and tub. Doors open to a screened-in porch with a stunning grilling area and outdoor wicker furniture, overlooking the inviting pool area.Ascending to the second floor, discover two guest bedrooms with king beds, sharing a bath with a shower. Adjacent is another primary bedroom with a king bed and a private bathroom with a shower. The hallway features a bunk area with a twin-over-twin bunk bed and a private bath with a shower/tub combo. An additional sleeping space offers a queen-over-queen bunk.The third floor is an entertainment haven with a Peloton bike, Foosball, and two queen beds. Unwind and savor every moment at this distinctive vacation home, featuring a total of two queen beds on this floor.Book your stay at "Heaven on 30A" today! (Note: Weddings are not allowed at this home. Violation may result in eviction, forfeiture of rental payments, and fines.)SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 18):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Half Bath: Toilet Only- Half Bath: Toilet OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Hallway Bunk Area: Twin over Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Additional Sleeping: Queen over Queen BunkTHIRD FLOOR:* Additional Sleeping: Two Queen Beds*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue Rentals fines.

body_text_excerpt: Destinations Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Seacrest Beach "Heaven on 30A" 145 Clareon Drive Seacrest Beach, FL Short Term Rental #STR-098554 Bedrooms 4 Beds 14 Sleeps 18 Full Baths 4 Half Baths 2 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Private gated beach access - Short stroll to the beach - Low-Speed Vehicle and bike parking at beach access. - Complimentary lithium battery golf cart - Private pool with screened-in patio, grilling area, and outdoor dining - Professionally decorated interior - Entertainment options include table games, cornhole, and a foosball table - Fitness enthusiasts can enjoy a Peloton bike - Fiber internet with lightning-fast speeds up to 2 Gbps - Convenient amenities: 4 adult bikes, 7 beach chairs, gas fire pit - Rigorous cleanliness with Complete Clean Linen Participant certification - Enjoy plush, complimentary beach towels for your use throughout your stay Details: Discover the epitome of 30A coastal living at "Heaven on 30A." This 3-story, 4-bedroom retreat, boasting 4 baths plus 2 half-baths, accommodates up to 18 guests and is a mere stroll or bike ride from Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, and The Big Chill. The chef’s kitchen, adorned with marble countertops and designer cabinets, features premium stainless Jenn-Air appliances, including a 6-burner gas stove and a Keurig coffeemaker. The dining area offers bar seating for 5 and a farm table for 10, complemented by a half-bath for convenience. Relax in either of the two living rooms, one with a generous 65” TV and a cozy sectional, the other featuring a love seat and comfortable chairs with a 55” TV. The first floor also hosts a laundry room for keeping your vacation wardrobe fresh. The primary bedroom, located on the first floor, boasts a private bath with a shower and tub. Doors open to a screened-in porch with a stunning grilling area and outdoor wicker furniture, overlooking the inviting pool area. Ascending to the second floor, discover two guest bedrooms with king beds, sharing a bath with a shower. Adjacent is another primary bedroom with a king bed and a private bathroom with a shower. The hallway features a bunk area with a twin-over-twin bunk bed and a private bath with a shower/tub combo. An additional sleeping space offers a queen-over-queen bunk. The third floor is an entertainment haven with a Peloton bike, Foosball, and two queen beds. Unwind and savor every moment at this distinctive vacation home, featuring a total of two queen beds on this floor. Book your stay at "Heaven on 30A" today! (Note: Weddings are not allowed at this home. Violation may result in eviction, forfeiture of rental payments, and fines.)
